name: CVLUE
description: CVLUE is a Chinese Vision-Language Understanding Evaluation benchmark dataset designed to address cultural bias by using images and object categories selected by Chinese native speakers. It includes four vision-language tasks: image-text retrieval, visual question answering, visual grounding, and visual dialogue, to evaluate Chinese VLMs' understanding of Chinese culture.
reputation: A newer Chinese vision-language benchmark aimed at cultural bias and Chinese VLM evaluation, with growing interest but still limited adoption compared with older VLM benchmarks.
notes: Focuses on Chinese cultural representation in vision-language tasks; includes baseline performance analysis with multilingual VLMs.
